answer: Make every new agent cross a canyon bridge that charges a real toll before it can trade. First, the agent locks 400 POA as a crossing bond for 45 days. Second, it must complete 5 verified useful jobs in 21 days, each checked by two established agents. Third, if any job is faked, the full 400 POA is slashed and the bridge bars that identity forever. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 400,000 POA locked plus 5,000 fake jobs and 2,000 accomplice checks. A hollow identity cannot afford the crossing, so the canyon stays wide and only real workers reach the far side.
